data.name: wotr_mod.spell.emperors_wrath.description
data.value: You fry your enemies with a stream of electrical energy. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 3rd, to a maximum of three rays at 11th level. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack and deals 4d6 electricity damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.frost_blast.description
data.value: You blast your enemies with a torrent of cold energy. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 3rd, to a maximum of three rays at 11th level. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack and deals 4d6 cold damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.caustic_beam.description
data.value: You blast your enemies with a ray of acid. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 3rd, to a maximum of three rays at 11th level. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack and deals 4d6 acid damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.force_ray.description
data.value: You blast your enemies with a ray of pure force. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 3rd, to a maximum of three rays at 11th level. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack and deals 4d4 force damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.bone_spike.description
data.value: A spike of bone forms from the other side and strikes the target, dealing 1d6+1 unholy damage. The spike strikes unerringly so long as the target has less than total cover or total concealment. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional spike, to a maximum of five spikes at 9th level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.acid_missile.description
data.value: A mass of acid strikes the target, dealing 1d6+1 acid damage. The missile strikes unerringly so long as the target has less than total cover or total concealment. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile, to a maximum of five missiles at 9th level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.fire_missile.description
data.value: A blazing bolt of fire strikes the target, dealing 1d6+1 fire damage. The missile strikes unerringly so long as the target has less than total cover or total concealment. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile, to a maximum of five missiles at 9th level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.electric_missile.description
data.value: A crackling surge of electricity strikes the target, dealing 1d6+1 electricity damage. The missile strikes unerringly so long as the target has less than total cover or total concealment. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile, to a maximum of five missiles at 9th level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.ice_missile.description
data.value: A shard of freezing ice strikes the target, dealing 1d6+1 cold damage. The missile strikes unerringly so long as the target has less than total cover or total concealment. For every two caster levels beyond 1st, you gain an additional missile, to a maximum of five missiles at 9th level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.vitriolic_blast.description
data.value: A vitriolic mass flies to the target point and erupts in a 20-foot burst. The caustic energy deals 1d6 acid damage per caster level, maximum 10d6, to creatures in the area. A successful Reflex save halves the damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.corrosive_cascade.description
data.value: A line of acid tears through enemies in its path, dealing 1d6 acid damage per caster level, maximum 12d6. A successful Reflex save halves the damage. Creatures struck corrode for 2d6 acid damage each round for 2 rounds. Creatures that fail their save also take a -2 penalty to AC for 1 round.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.frozen_lance.description
data.value: A precise lance of cold strikes with a ranged touch attack, dealing 8d8 cold damage. A creature that fails its Fortitude save is staggered for 1 round. If the creature was already slowed or staggered, it is immobilized in ice for 1 round instead.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.thunderhead.description
data.value: You conjure a 20-foot-radius storm cloud that lasts 1 round per caster level. Enemies entering the cloud or beginning a round inside it take 4d6 electricity damage. Each round, lightning arcs from affected enemies to a random nearby enemy for 2d6 electricity damage. Enemies that fail a Fortitude save are dazed and dazzled for 1 round.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.fire_storm.description
data.value: Sheets of roaring flame erupt in the target area and persist for 3 rounds. Enemies in the area take 1d8 fire damage per caster level, maximum 20d8. A successful Reflex save halves each instance of damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.meteor_swarm.description
data.value: Meteor Swarm causes meteors to rain down in a 45-foot radius. Creatures in the area take 8d12 bludgeoning damage from the meteors and 24d6 fire damage from the explosion. A successful Reflex save halves both damage instances. Spell resistance does not apply.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.vitriolic_sphere.description
data.value: A volatile sphere of acid erupts in a 30-foot burst up to 90 feet away, dealing 1d8 acid damage per caster level, maximum 15d8. The blast ignores the first 10 points of acid resistance. A successful Reflex save halves the damage. Creatures that fail their save are nauseated by caustic fumes for 1 round.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.absolute_zero.description
data.value: You unleash an impossible wave of cold in a 30-foot cone, dealing 1d8 cold damage per caster level, maximum 15d8. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and slows the creature for 3 rounds. A creature that fails the save is petrified in ice for 1 round.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.dissolution_wave.description
data.value: You release a sweeping wave of acid in a 40-foot cone, dealing 1d8 acid damage per caster level, maximum 20d8. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage. A creature that fails the save is corroded, taking a -4 natural armor penalty for 3 rounds.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.glacial_prison.description
data.value: You freeze the battlefield in a 40-foot radius for 1 round per caster level. Enemies entering the area or beginning their turn within it take 1d8 cold damage per caster level and treat the terrain as difficult terrain. Enemies that fail a Reflex save are entangled in ice; entangled enemies that then fail a Fortitude save are paralyzed in ice.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.cataclysmic_storm.description
data.value: You call down a massive 40-foot-radius storm for 1 round per caster level. Hostile creatures entering the storm or beginning their turn within it are struck for 1d8 electricity damage per caster level. Creatures that fail a Reflex save are knocked prone.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.polar_catastrophe.description
data.value: You summon a 40-foot-radius polar maelstrom for 1 round per caster level. Hostile creatures entering the storm or beginning their turn within it are struck for 1d8 cold damage per caster level. Creatures that fail a Fortitude save are left exhausted for 1 round.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.caustic_oblivion.description
data.value: You fire a long-range ray of annihilating acid with a ranged touch attack. The target takes 20d10 acid damage and continues burning for 8d6 acid damage each round for 3 rounds. A successful Fortitude save halves the initial damage; a failed save blinds the target for 3 rounds. The acid ignores energy immunity.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.heavens_wrath.description
data.value: You call down repeated colossal lightning strikes in a 40-foot radius for 1 round per caster level. Enemies entering the storm or beginning their turn within it take 1d12 electricity damage per caster level. A creature that fails its Fortitude save is stunned for 1 round, and lightning jumps to nearby enemies for 6d12 electricity damage. Creatures wearing armor take a -4 penalty on the saving throw.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.vitriolic_apocalypse.description
data.value: A catastrophic sphere of abyss-tainted acid blossoms outward in a 40-foot-radius spread up to 120 feet away, dissolving matter at the molecular level. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage per caster level plus 1d8 unholy damage per caster level. A successful Reflex save halves the initial damage. Creatures that fail their save suffer Molecular Dissolution for 3 rounds. Spell resistance applies.

data.name: wotr_mod.buff.molecular_dissolution.description
data.value: The creature takes 8d8 acid damage at the start of each turn, suffers a -6 penalty to AC, and has its movement speed reduced by 50%.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.acid_hellfire_ray.description
data.value: You fire a ray of hellfire that requires a ranged touch attack to hit. Each ray deals 1d6 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6; half of the damage is acid and half is unholy. You gain one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of three rays at caster level 19. The rays can be aimed at the same or different targets, but all targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.cold_hellfire_ray.description
data.value: You fire a ray of hellfire that requires a ranged touch attack to hit. Each ray deals 1d6 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6; half of the damage is cold and half is unholy. You gain one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of three rays at caster level 19. The rays can be aimed at the same or different targets, but all targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.electric_hellfire_ray.description
data.value: You fire a ray of hellfire that requires a ranged touch attack to hit. Each ray deals 1d6 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6; half of the damage is electricity and half is unholy. You gain one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of three rays at caster level 19. The rays can be aimed at the same or different targets, but all targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.fire_hellfire_ray.description
data.value: You fire a ray of hellfire that requires a ranged touch attack to hit. Each ray deals 1d6 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6; half of the damage is fire and half is unholy. You gain one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of three rays at caster level 19. The rays can be aimed at the same or different targets, but all targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.shadow_hellfire_ray.description
data.value: You unleash a stream of shadowblight that requires a ranged touch attack to hit. Each stream deals 1d6 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6; half of the damage is negative energy and half is unholy. You gain one additional stream for every four caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of three streams at caster level 19. The streams can be aimed at the same or different targets, but all targets must be within 30 feet of each other.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.corpse_explosion.description
data.value: You detonate a corpse in a 15-foot burst, dealing 1d8 unholy damage per caster level to creatures caught in the explosion.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.eldritch_horror.description
data.value: A terrifying force from beyond creeps from the ground to ensnare and harm your enemies. Creatures that fail their saving throw are entangled and take unholy damage that increases with caster level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.gravebolt_cascade.description
data.value: You fire three bolts of negative energy that can strike one or more enemy targets. Each bolt deals 1d8 points of negative energy damage + 1 point per caster level. Undead targets are healed by this amount instead. A creature struck by a bolt must succeed at a Fortitude save or become sickened for 1 round.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.hell_on_earth.description
data.value: You summon Hell itself to assault your enemies. Arms of the dead burst from the ground to ensnare and rip apart foes, dealing 1d12 unholy damage per caster level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.death_ray.description
data.value: You fire a ray of deathly energy. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four caster levels beyond 3rd, to a maximum of three rays at 11th level. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack and deals 4d6 negative energy damage.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.harvest_soul.description
data.value: You tear at a single enemy's soul, dealing 1d6 negative energy damage per caster level, to a maximum of 25d6. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage. If this damage kills the target, you restore one expended spell slot of the selected level.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.despair_of_sepulchre.description
data.value: You emanate the terror of death in a 20-foot aura for 1 round per caster level. Enemies inside the aura take a -4 penalty to attack rolls, take a -4 penalty on saving throws against death effects, and become fatigued while they remain inside.

data.name: wotr_mod.spell.harvest_the_fallen.description
data.value: You siphon lingering life essence from nearby corpses and dying enemies in a 30-foot radius. For each dead enemy or enemy below 25% hit points in the area, you heal yourself for 1d8 + caster level and gain temporary hit points equal to twice your caster level for 10 minutes per caster level. You can gain a maximum of 5 temporary hit point stacks from this spell.
